item.title: Grok scandal prompts MEP move to ban non-consensual AI porn in new omnibus
item.description: A new draft report by Green MEP Sergey Lagodinsky aims to amend the AI Omnibus proposal to prohibit generative apps that can generate nonconsensual sensualised content.

item.title: EU goes tactical, as Trump lets START nuclear arms deal expire
item.description: Any new US-Russia deal on strategic nuclear bombs would have mostly "symbolic" value, as France and Germany focus on tactical threats instead.

item.title: TikTok’s addictive design breaches the DSA, EU Commission finds
item.description: The European Commission preliminarily found TikTok in violation of the Digital Services Act on Friday, for breaching the EU’s addictive design rules — such as not adequately assessing addiction risk and implementing weak mitigation features

item.title: What Europe can learn from Finland on civilian and military preparedness
item.description: As the EU Commission implements its Preparedness Union Strategy announced in March 2025, Finland stands among the very few member states that have already operationalised what Brussels is still designing.

item.title: Listen: Is the EU well prepared for a threat from Russia?
item.description: Are Europeans truly ready for a Russian threat? As Ukraine endures war and peace talks stall, Léa Marchal examines EU defence preparedness, spending gaps, and the warnings of President Zelensky. Is Europe acting fast enough? The short answer is no.

item.title: North Africa holds key to EU-Africa trade boost, says IMF chief
item.description: North African countries can drive a multi-billion euro increase in EU-Africa trade, IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva told a conference in Algiers.

item.title: EU calls foul on FIFA’s Russia reinstatement bid
item.description: The European Commission has voiced opposition to Russia’s reinstatement in international football, following FIFA’s announcement that it is ready to lift the ban imposed in 2022 after Moscow’s invasion of Ukraine.

item.title: Russian satellite manoeuvring toward EU spying-risk zone
item.description: Russia's 'Cosmos-2589' satellite is one to watch for future spying on EU signals, after Moscow's older model joined a "graveyard".

item.title: How Epstein and Bannon tried to reshape EU politics, hated Merkel
item.description: The Epstein files show not only how he abused women and girls while mixing with powerful people, but also how he tried to influence politics in Europe.

item.title: THIS WEEK: EU leaders’ retreat on competitiveness, Munich Security Conference, and Ukraine
item.description: This week, EU leaders will meet in Alden Biesen to discuss economic reforms and competitiveness, while the Munich Security Conference takes place from Friday to Sunday. In Strasbourg, MEPs will vote on housing, defence, climate, migration, and Ukraine aid.
